title: Sunlit Slopes
description: Cross the valley floor, ascend grassy and rocky slopes, reach the upper meadow and descend a long sunlit hillside. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The valley floor
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

The grassy incline
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

The rocky sun slope
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

The bright upper meadow
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

The long downhill
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The valley floor
rooms.lesson: Low jumps lead to the rising hillside. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The grassy incline
rooms.lesson: Aim diagonally up the stepping hillside. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The rocky sun slope
rooms.lesson: Larger diagonal gaps climb the exposed rock. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The bright upper meadow
rooms.lesson: Catch your rhythm on the broad upper meadow. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The long downhill
rooms.lesson: Carry each landing into the next descending terrace. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.
